title: Gender Differences and Age Related Differences in Emergency Department Admission
official: Gender Differences and Age Related Differences in Emergency Department Admission
summary: The goal of this observational study is to learn about difference related to age and gender in patients admitted to emergency department.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age over 18 y
* Admitted to emergency department

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age under 18 y
sponsor: Fondazione Policlinico Universitario Agostino Gemelli IRCCS
